name: Freight Cost Report
purpose: Calculates freight cost per kilogram for each carrier, lane and pickup week

inputs.shipment_id: ID the shipper uses to refer to the shipment
inputs.carrier_name: Name of the company that carried the shipment
inputs.origin_city: City the shipment was picked up from
inputs.destination_city: City the shipment was delivered to
inputs.pickup_date: Date the carrier picked up the shipment
inputs.chargeable_weight_kg: Weight the carrier charged for (the higher of actual and dimensional weight), in kilograms
inputs.freight_charge: Base charge for moving the shipment, before fuel surcharge, extra charges and tax
inputs.fuel_surcharge_pct: Fuel surcharge as a percentage of the base charge
inputs.customs_duty: Import duty paid on the shipment
inputs.driver_name: Name of the driver who carried the shipment
